title: ShutterCount Camera Health Weekly Review Interval Trend
dataSources: Lightroom photo exports (`lightroom:photo`), Flickr photo metadata (`flickr:photo`), ShutterCount body audits (`shuttercount:camera`), and F3 card tests (`f3:card`).
app: Adobe Lightroom exports, Flickr API metadata, ShutterCount camera audits, and F3 SD-card health checks sent to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=shuttercount:camera days_since_audit=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(days_since_audit) as avg_duration, max(days_since_audit) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst review interval for ShutterCount camera health events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture days_since_audit on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average review interval with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It reminds whether ShutterCount camera health tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
